mapper.select: SELECT rp.id AS recipe_id, rp.title, CONCAT(#{baseUrl}, img.stored_name) AS image_url, rp.difficulty, rp.prep_time, rp.description, rf.is_specialty FROM region_food rf INNER JOIN region r ON r.code = rf.region_code INNER JOIN recipes rp ON rp.id = rf.recipe_id LEFT JOIN image_management img ON img.id = rp.image_id WHERE r.code = #{regionCode} ORDER BY rf.is_specialty DESC, rf.sort ASC, rp.id DESC
